summary.zh-Hans: 罗马斗兽场又名弗拉维圆形剧场，建于公元1世纪。建筑外立面分为四层，下面三层排列着拱门。
summary.en: Built in the 1st century CE, the Colosseum is also known as the Flavian Amphitheatre. Its exterior has four architectural levels, with rows of arches on the lower three.

summary.zh-Hans: 万神殿的穹顶中央留有圆形天窗，自然光由此进入室内。穹顶内侧一圈圈逐渐收拢的凹格围着这个开口。
summary.en: A circular opening at the crown of the Pantheon's dome admits daylight. Rings of recessed panels grow smaller as they rise toward the opening.

summary.zh-Hans: 卡尔博纳拉是罗马的代表意面之一，常见的传统做法使用鸡蛋、猪颊肉、佩科里诺奶酪和黑胡椒。蛋与奶酪拌成包裹面条的酱汁。
summary.en: Carbonara is a Roman pasta dish traditionally made with eggs, guanciale, pecorino and black pepper. Egg and cheese form the sauce that coats the pasta.

summary.zh-Hans: 苏普利是罗马的炸米饭点心，外面有薄脆的面包屑外皮，里面是调味米饭和马苏里拉奶酪。奶酪融化后可以拉出细丝。
summary.en: Supplì are Roman rice croquettes with a thin, crisp breadcrumb coating. Seasoned rice surrounds mozzarella, which can stretch into a thread when melted.
